data.title: Update master feedback presets and program menu

data.body: Implemented requested preset/menu updates: spectrogram default window 30s; Programs menu filtered to debug/master_feedback; Master presets now default/alpha/alpha_theta/smr/custom; alpha_theta_beta and debug removed from Master presets; preset labels no longer include Feedback; Master active/base global track removed so reward audio comes from Play audio bands; theta reward tracks default to Creek; presets updated to requested log-power thresholds/holds/no-SFX mute roles; Default preset added. Verification: python -m pytest tests/test_programs.py passed; npm run build:frontend passed.

Completed preset/menu update. Changed spectral history default window to 30s; filtered Programs menu to Debug and Master Feedback; removed alpha-theta-beta and debug from Master presets; added Default preset; updated Alpha, Alpha Theta, and SMR thresholds/holds/features/roles; removed the Master global active/base audio track so Play audio band tracks are the only reward audio; made theta tracks default to Creek; updated backend tests. Verification passed: python -m pytest tests/test_programs.py and npm run build:frontend.
